_sources: Driver floors: NVIDIA, CUDA Toolkit 13.4 Update 1 release notes, 'Driver Range for Minor Version Compatibility': CUDA 13.x runs on driver 580 or newer, CUDA 12.x on 525 or newer.

Compute capabilities: PyTorch v2.14.0, .ci/manywheel/build_env_setup.py, TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST_TABLE for x86_64 release wheels (SASS only): CUDA 12.6 builds sm_50 to sm_90, CUDA 13.0 builds sm_75 to sm_120. NVIDIA's CUDA 13 notes: support for Maxwell, Pascal and Volta was removed.
Wheels: torch 2.14.0 has cp314 wheels for win_amd64 and manylinux x86_64 on the cu130, cu126 and cpu indexes (checked 2026-09-29).
disk_mb is left out until the hardware report measures a real install.
title: PyTorch
summary: PyTorch alone, with no model code: the runtime the hardware report checks.
